title: Musings on the Riemann Hypothesis
summary: We present a few ideas on the Riemann Hypothesis based on properties of analytic functions in the complex plane. In particular, we focus on the real and imaginary parts of the Riemann xi ($ξ$) function whose zeros coincide with those of the zeta ($ζ$) function within the critical strip. We discuss the forms of the zero contour lines of the two conjugate harmonic functions (the real and imaginary parts of xi) and consider where their intersections could conceivably occur.
